description: Hap1 (basic HAP, BC1 RGB, no alpha) decode + upload regression gate. Loads a tiny BC1 .mov fixture, seeks, hashes the compose target. Verifies the BC1 path end-to-end: HAPDecoder routes Hap1 to TextureFormat::BC1_UNORM (8 bytes/block, half the size of BC3) and the compositor samples it as plain RGBA via colorSpace=Linear. Distinct golden from hap_roundtrip (BC3) and hap_q_roundtrip (YCoCg) — a regression in BC1 row-pitch math or DXGI_FORMAT_BC1_UNORM wiring will mismatch this hash. Fixture: `generate_hap_fixture <dst> hap 64 64 16 30`.
